abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Alvenor. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Alvenor.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Alvenor. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Alvenor.
section:
### Additional comparison

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 5. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 173 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 140 | 650 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 167 | 650 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 142 | 650 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 13.2 | 6.6 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 9.8 | 4.9 | 650 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 11.8 | 5.9 | 650 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 10.1 | 5.0 | 650 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
